title: [AUG-171] Research: remember Praxis projects picked by folder in the Send to Praxis dialog
why_we_need_this: Rodion's feedback (Bug Fix 2): in Send to Praxis, a project chosen via folder picker is not kept in the Project dropdown, so the path has to be selected again every time. Vlad's concern: auto-saving every pick leads to 15 junk projects after mistakes. Agreed minimum from the discussion: keep the last chosen path; possible extension — save picks with an [x] remove button. Source: @docs/feedback/2026-11-rodion-feedback.md
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Current flow described with file:line refs: how praxisProjects / default project are stored and how the folder pick is handled (AUG-142 multi-project).
- [ ] Options compared: (a) remember last picked path only, (b) auto-add picks to the dropdown with [x] removal, (c) other — with UX and data trade-offs.
- [ ] HTML mockup: a self-contained file @docs/mockups/AUG-171/send-to-praxis.html (opens in a browser, no build) showing the Send to Praxis dialog for each option side by side — dropdown with saved projects, [x] removal, last-path field; built on August's real design tokens (frontend-design route, 0 border-radius).
- [ ] Recommendation given; the user picks an option on the mockup (AskUserQuestion); the decision is recorded in this card.
- [ ] CLOSURE CONDITION: an implementation task with the agreed scope, SMART acceptance criteria and a link to the chosen mockup is created on the board; its ID is written into this card and into the roadmap line in @project-context/roadmap/README.md.
important_constraints:
Research only — no code changes. Closed only by creating the agreed implementation task. Paths must stay cross-platform (Windows non-ASCII / 8.3 paths, macOS). Roadmap: M1 Quick fixes. Order: 2/10.

## Research result (2026-11-05)
**Root cause:** the last path is already saved, but in localStorage (@client/src/components/PraxisModal.tsx:80,102-126, written only after a successful send at :186-199). The packaged app starts the server on port 0 (@electron/src/main.ts:195,610), so the origin and its localStorage change on every launch. "Open" (:142-155) only fills the path field and never registers a project.
**Options:** A = last path in server prefs; B = auto-add to praxisProjects with ×; C = separate Recent list with ×/Save. See @docs/mockups/AUG-171/send-to-praxis.html.
**Decision (Vlad):** C, cap **5** (the mockup draws 3).
**Implementation task:** AUG-192-t44nnd. Roadmap line updated.

## ✅ Итог (2026-11-05)
**Что сделано:**
- Найдена причина: последний путь хранится в localStorage, а упакованное приложение каждый запуск стартует сервер на новом порту (port 0) → новый origin → localStorage пуст.
- Сравнены 3 варианта (A последний путь в server prefs, B авто-добавление в praxisProjects с ×, C отдельный список Recent с × и Save).
- HTML-мокап с тремя вариантами рядом на токенах August, 0 radius.
- Решение Влада: C, лимит 5. Создана задача AUG-192.
**Как:** C выбран, потому что даёт переиспользование в один клик (просьба Родиона) и сам ограничивает мусор (опасение Влада), не засоряя Settings → Projects. B отвергнут: неверные, но валидные выборы засоряют зарегистрированный список. A — подмножество C. Общие правила: путь добавлять только после успешного создания задачи; хранить в server prefs, не в localStorage; дедуп по resolved path без учёта регистра; путь хранить как выбран (не 8.3).
**Файлы:** @docs/mockups/AUG-171/send-to-praxis.html, @project-context/roadmap/README.md, @project-context/frontend-design/README.md (раздел Praxis Modal).
**PR / коммиты:** 604bd65 в master (без PR).
**Грабли:** на мокапе нарисован лимит 3, в решении — 5; в AUG-192 записано 5. Мокап не открывали в браузере (проверены только синтаксис JS и токены).
**Хвосты:** реализация — AUG-192 (уже in_progress). Не проверено: возможно, Windows FolderBrowserDialog через stdout PowerShell портит не-ASCII пути — это вынесено в критерий AUG-192.
